Charizard.name: Mega X Belly Drum
Charizard.label: Mega Belly Drum sweeper
Charizard.description: Mega Evolves with Tough Claws, Belly Drums, and hits with maxed Flare Blitz and Dragon Claw.

Clefable.name: Belly Drum
Clefable.label: Belly Drum sweeper
Clefable.description: Magic Guard means Life Orb costs it nothing: Belly Drum, heal, then hit hard.

Lopunny.name: Choice Scarf Healing Wish
Lopunny.label: Choice Scarf support
Lopunny.description: Outspeeds and hits, Tricks its Scarf onto a wall, or faints with Healing Wish to fully heal a teammate.

Aggron.name: Rock Polish
Aggron.label: Rock Polish sweeper
Aggron.description: Skips the Mega Stone: Rock Head means Head Smash has no recoil, and Rock Polish gives it Speed.

Mew.name: Swords Dance
Mew.label: Swords Dance sweeper
Mew.description: Mew can learn almost anything; this one boosts with Swords Dance and attacks physically.

Whimsicott.name: SubSeed Encore
Whimsicott.label: Substitute + Leech Seed staller
Whimsicott.description: Prankster Substitute, Leech Seed, and Encore lock foes into useless moves while it drains them.

Sceptile.name: SubSeed
Sceptile.label: Substitute + Leech Seed staller
Sceptile.description: Skips the Mega Stone to hide behind Substitute and drain foes with Leech Seed and Giga Drain.

Shuckle.name: Red Card hazard lead
Shuckle.label: Hazard lead
Shuckle.description: Sets Sticky Web and Stealth Rock, Red Cards attackers away, and goes out with Final Gambit.
